clauses.scope_note: Acceptable Use Policy, lines 47–61: prohibition on using or allowing others to use Meta Llama 3 for the listed conduct. The sensitive-information restriction is limited to cases lacking rights and consents required by applicable law; the professional-practice restriction applies to unauthorized or unlicensed practice.
clauses.condition_explanation: Each atom denotes the corresponding prohibited category in lines 49–61. The listed categories are alternatives. The sensitive-information category covers collecting, processing, disclosing, generating, or inferring health, demographic, or other sensitive personal or private information without legally required rights and consents. The rights-violation category expressly includes outputs or results of products or services using Llama Materials.

obligation_items.content: Do not use Meta Llama 3, or allow others to use it, for any of the prohibited categories stated in the condition.
obligation_items.actor: Licensee and persons the licensee allows to use Meta Llama 3
obligation_items.object: Meta Llama 3 and conduct or content generated, facilitated, or otherwise produced through its use, including covered outputs or results
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever use of Meta Llama 3 would engage in, promote, facilitate, or otherwise involve any prohibited category in the condition; the sensitive-information category applies only absent rights and consents required by applicable laws, and the professional-practice category applies to unauthorized or unlicensed practice.

clauses.scope_note: Acceptable Use Policy, lines 63–69: prohibition on engaging in, promoting, inciting, facilitating, or assisting in planning or developing activities presenting a risk of death or bodily harm, including the listed examples.
clauses.condition_explanation: The categories are alternatives. The military-related category includes warfare, nuclear industries or applications, espionage, and materials or activities subject to ITAR maintained by the U.S. Department of State. The policy gives guns and illegal weapons, illegal drugs and regulated or controlled substances, operation of critical infrastructure, transportation technologies or heavy machinery, self-harm or harm to others, and specified violent content as included examples.

obligation_items.content: Do not use Meta Llama 3 to engage in, promote, incite, facilitate, or assist in planning or developing any activity presenting a risk of death or bodily harm covered by the condition.
obligation_items.actor: Licensee and persons the licensee allows to use Meta Llama 3
obligation_items.object: Meta Llama 3 and the covered activities or content
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the use engages in, promotes, incites, facilitates, or assists in planning or developing a risk-of-death-or-bodily-harm activity in the condition.

clauses.scope_note: Acceptable Use Policy, lines 71–78: prohibition on intentional deception or misleading, including the listed uses. The impersonation restriction has the stated consent, authorization, or legal-right exception.
clauses.condition_explanation: The listed grounds are alternatives. Intentional deception or misleading includes generating, promoting, or furthering fraud or disinformation; generating, promoting, or furthering defamatory content; generating, promoting, or further distributing spam; impersonating another individual without consent, authorization, or legal right; representing use of Meta Llama 3 or its outputs as human-generated; and generating or facilitating false online engagement.

obligation_items.content: Do not intentionally deceive or mislead others through a use listed in the condition.
obligation_items.actor: Licensee and persons the licensee allows to use Meta Llama 3
obligation_items.object: Meta Llama 3 and associated uses or outputs
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the use intentionally deceives or misleads others by a listed means; impersonation is covered when it lacks consent, authorization, or legal right.

clauses.scope_note: Acceptable Use Policy, line 78: the prohibition on failing to appropriately disclose known dangers of the licensee’s AI system to end users entails a disclosure duty when such dangers are known.
clauses.condition_explanation: known_ai_system_dangers means dangers of the licensee’s AI system known to the responsible actor. The required disclosure is to end users and must be appropriate; the policy does not specify a disclosure format or timing.

obligation_items.content: Appropriately disclose known dangers of the AI system to end users.
obligation_items.actor: Licensee or other person responsible for the AI system
obligation_items.object: Known dangers of the licensee’s AI system and the end users to whom they must be disclosed
obligation_items.trigger: When the responsible actor knows of dangers of the AI system; disclose those known dangers appropriately to end users.

coverage_notes: The Acceptable Use Policy is identified as applicable when the recipient accesses or uses Meta Llama 3 (line 45); the most recent policy is referenced at an external URL, whose later contents are not supplied and are not inferred.

The reporting paragraph is an operative request to report specified issues, but no allowed activity represents reporting. Its reporting duty is therefore identified as unresolved rather than mapped to an inaccurate activity.

paragraph_audit.reason: Lines 47–61 prohibit use or allowing others to use Meta Llama 3 for the enumerated unlawful, rights-violating, harmful, privacy-sensitive, professional-practice, and system-impairment categories; the clause preserves stated qualifications.
Lines 63–69 prohibit the listed risk-of-death-or-bodily-harm activities, including the specified examples.
Lines 71–78 prohibit the enumerated intentional deceptive uses and separately require appropriate disclosure to end users of known dangers of the AI system.

Lines 80–84 request reporting policy violations, bugs, risky generated content, security concerns, and unlicensed uses through listed channels. Reporting is an operative requested action but cannot be faithfully represented by an allowed activity; the channels are not modeled as a different action.
